text.card: A red giant 2,513 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.86 solar masses and 9.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,820 K at its surface.
